name: Ceiling-Drilling Robot Set-Up
label: SYNTHETIC — a scripted expert at skill 0.85 with action noise standing in for a person; no learner episode is in this set

safePractice.text: Ran the drill while a person was inside the barricade; the robot held until they stepped out.
Drilled before the deck was scanned for embedded services.
Drilled before the barricade around the robot's reach was set.
Drilled with the dust collection switched off.
Changed the drill bit without isolating the battery first.
